chapters.reason: The paper introduces DNR Bench, a new benchmark designed to evaluate LLMs' ability to avoid unnecessary generation and over-reasoning, explicitly focusing on measuring reasoning efficiency and overthinking phenomena.

The paper evaluates reasoning LLMs that use test-time scaling (increased reasoning depth/compute during inference) and highlights their inefficiency, which relates to the study of efficient test-time scaling.
The paper identifies excessive token generation as a problem, which implicitly relates to the challenge of managing reasoning length, though it does not propose a solution with length rewards.
